results.text: What is the total order value per logistics provider?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT lp.display_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN fulfillments f ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN logistics_providers lp ON f.provider_id = lp.provider_id
GROUP BY lp.display_name
LIMIT 1000;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT lp.provider_id, lp.display_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_order_value FROM logistics_providers lp JOIN fulfillments f ON f.provider_id = lp.provider_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = f.order_id GROUP BY lp.provider_id, lp.display_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC

results.text: Which cities have both a seller and a logistics provider hub located in them?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT l1.city, l2.city 
FROM logistics_providers AS lp 
JOIN locations AS l1 ON lp.hub_location_id = l1.location_id 
JOIN sellers AS s ON lp.provider_id = s.seller_id 
JOIN fulfillments AS f ON s.seller_id = f.order_id::text 
JOIN locations AS l2 ON f.provider_id::text = l2.location_id 
LIMIT 1000
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.city FROM locations l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sellers s WHERE s.location_id = l.location_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_providers lp WHERE lp.hub_location_id = l.location_id) ORDER BY l.city
